sermon.title: Why is Moses’ Tabernacle important for Christians today?
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A one-minute clip from Hebrews 8:5: the tabernacle Moses built was a copy and shadow pointing to heavenly realities.

chunks.section_question: Why does Moses’ tabernacle matter to Christians?
chunks.short_answer: It was a copy and shadow of heavenly things; earthly shadows point us to the real thing.
chunks.text: In Hebrews chapter 8 verse 5 the tabernacle Moses’s tabernacle served as the copy and shadow. Of heavenly things. As Moses was divinely instructed when he was about to make the tabernacle so if you look here I got a shadow right. If you follow the shadow a man but a picture or a shadow is just a representation of the real thing it is not the real thing so God makes these shadows. Or earthly things to. Point us to what the heavenly thing the real thing. For he said see that you make all things according to the pattern shown you on the mountain according to the shadow so in the New Testament he helps us understand why these things were made they are pointing us to the real thing.

faqs.question: What was the tabernacle?
faqs.answer: A copy and shadow of heavenly things.

faqs.question: How was Moses instructed?
faqs.answer: Divinely, to make all things according to the pattern shown on the mountain.

faqs.question: Is a shadow the real thing?
faqs.answer: No, only a representation of it.

faqs.question: Why does God make shadows?
faqs.answer: To point us to the heavenly, real thing.

faqs.question: How does the New Testament help?
faqs.answer: It explains why these things were made.

faqs.question: What pattern is meant?
faqs.answer: The one shown to Moses on the mountain.

faqs.question: Why study it today?
faqs.answer: Because it points to the real thing.
